Position.title: Position
Position.description: Represents a specific job role or position within OPEC Manpower Supply, defining its core characteristics and requirements.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Position entity.

positionName.description: The official, human-readable name of the position (e.g., 'Welder', 'Rig Mechanic').

positionCode.description: A unique alphanumeric code identifying the position.

category.description: The broader category to which the position belongs (e.g., 'Offshore', 'Onshore', 'Technical', 'Administrative').

active.description: Indicates whether the position is currently active and can be assigned to workers.

description.description: A detailed description of the position's responsibilities, duties, and scope.

payrollBasis.description: The standard basis for calculating payroll for this position (e.g., 'Daily', 'Monthly', 'Hourly').

notes.description: Any additional internal notes or remarks relevant to the position.

Wave.title: Wave
Wave.description: Represents a deployment wave or rotation cycle for a group of workers.

PositionCertificateRequirement.title: PositionCertificateRequirement
PositionCertificateRequirement.description: Defines a specific certificate requirement for a particular position. These are managed as subcollections under the Position entity.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Position Certificate Requirement.

certificateName.description: The name of the required certificate (e.g., 'BOSIET', 'First Aid').

certificateCode.description: A unique alphanumeric code for the certificate type.

required.description: Indicates whether this certificate is strictly mandatory for the position.

validityMonths.description: The number of months the certificate is considered valid for this position. This field is optional.

notes.description: Any specific notes or additional context about this certificate requirement.

PositionPPERequirement.title: PositionPPERequirement
PositionPPERequirement.description: Defines a specific Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) requirement for a particular position. These are managed as subcollections under the Position entity.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Position PPE Requirement.

itemName.description: The name of the required PPE item (e.g., 'Safety Helmet', 'Coveralls').

itemCode.description: A unique alphanumeric code for the PPE item type.

quantityDefault.description: The default quantity of this PPE item required for the position.

required.description: Indicates whether this PPE item is strictly mandatory for the position.

notes.description: Any specific notes or additional context about this PPE requirement.

PositionToolRequirement.title: PositionToolRequirement
PositionToolRequirement.description: Defines an allowed tool or equipment item for a particular position. These are managed as subcollections under the Position entity.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Position Tool Requirement.

itemName.description: The name of the allowed tool or equipment item (e.g., 'Torque Wrench', 'Grinding Machine').

itemCode.description: A unique alphanumeric code for the tool or equipment item type.

quantityDefault.description: The default quantity of this item that is allowed/expected for the position.

allowed.description: Indicates whether this tool/equipment is allowed for use by this position.

notes.description: Any specific notes or additional context about this tool/equipment allowance.

definition.description: Top-level collection for all job positions.
Top-level collection for all deployment waves.
Subcollection storing specific certificate requirements for a parent Position.
Subcollection storing specific Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) requirements for a parent Position.
Subcollection storing allowed tools and equipment for a parent Position.
